rule: Launch runs the intro unless the splash is skipped (exult.cc:1112-1116). The Black Gate intro is five scenes in a fixed order (title, logo, guardian, desk, moongate); each scene catches a skip and moves on, and a break ends the whole chain. The menu sends Journey Onwards (game.cc:715-718) to a character setup (new_game, game.cc:732), then to init_gamedat, which restores the new-game state from the original data (gamewin.cc:1369-1370). The Quotes menu item shows only when quotes.flg exists; that flag is written when the Credits sequence is watched through (bggame.cc:1966-1967). Endgame shows when endgame.flg exists (writer not traced). The did_first_scene global keeps the Avatar hidden until the usecode opening scene has run (gamewin.cc:2913-2918). skip_intro=yes sets that global true (gamewin.cc:2909), which shows the Avatar and skips the opening scene.
